content.title: Municipal General Contractor License (Right-of-Way)
content.summary: The City of Arvada issues Municipal General Contractor Licenses for work in the right-of-way. New applicants and renewals must apply online through the Permit System, upload required documents, and pay applicable fees. License review may take up to 5 business days.

steps.title: Create an Account or Log In
steps.text: New applicants must create an account in the Permit System. For renewals, log in using your current AEC number.

steps.title: Apply for License
steps.text: For a new license, click on “Apply for Contractor License” under the contractor heading and follow the instructions. For renewals, follow the prompts to apply and submit.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.text: Upload all required documentation including the Municipal Bond Form, insurance certificates, and workers' compensation certificates with the City of Arvada listed as additional insured.

steps.title: Application Review
steps.text: The City will review your application and add fees. Review may take up to 5 business days.

steps.title: Payment and License Issuance
steps.text: You will receive an email notifying you that your license is ready for payment. After payment is collected, the City will send you your license.

required_documents.name: Municipal Bond Form
required_documents.description: A bond form with power of attorney required for the license.

required_documents.name: Insurance and Workman's Compensation Certificates
required_documents.description: Certificates listing the City of Arvada as additional insured. Examples are available under Resources on the permit page.
